body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target takes 1 weapon Damage. After resolving, yourself or a willing ally within 3 units may move up to 2 units.

surges.html: The moving creature ignores movement Reactions from hit targets.

rider.title: Lock - Salvo
rider.html: If a hit target is Locked, you may end Lock to grant the moving creature +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.
